newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Saks Holdings started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Saks Holdings started as buy.

text.p: -- Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Friday initiated coverage of Saks Holdings Inc with a buy rating, citing strong Christmas sales and "excellent growth opportunity through existing store renovation and new store expansion."

-- Analyst Dana Eisman Cohen said Saks has begun to substantially narrow the gap between themselves and its number-one competitor, Neiman Marcus Group Inc , through store remodeling, improved merchandise and higher service levels.
-- Cohen noted that same-store sales over Christmas were up 10.4 percent, compared to a 0.6 percent decline in same-store sales for Neiman-Marcus.
-- Saks Holdings is the parent of the Saks Fifth Avenue retail chain.
-- Its shares were trading down 1/4 Friday at 29-1/8.
